description: This file defines the interface for the em_simulator_t class, which encapsulates functionalities related to configuring and running an Easy Mesh agent in a Wi-Fi mesh simulation environment. It provides methods to retrieve command parameters, run the agent, and configure it with scan parameters. The class interacts with external types such as dm_easy_mesh_agent_t and em_scan_params_t, and includes a couple of external headers, em_base.h and dm_easy_mesh_agent.h.

classes.name: em_simulator_t
classes.description: A class that encapsulates simulation controls for the Easy Mesh agent, allowing configuration, execution, and retrieval of command parameters.

methods.name: get_cmd_param
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the command parameters for use in configuring the simulation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the Easy Mesh agent with the specified configuration.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the Easy Mesh agent with provided scan parameters.

methods.name: em_simulator_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new instance of the em_simulator_t class.

methods.name: ~em_simulator_t
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources used by the em_simulator_t instance.
